outcome.answer: Fernandes’ Brazilian legal document segmentation is best matched by Structural Segmentation for Brazilian Legal Document Retrieval [1]. [1] It studies structural segmentation for Brazilian legal document retrieval using the hierarchical structure of legal acts, comparing a multi-layered hierarchy with simplified chunk-based representations. [1] The closest related papers are JUÁ, a benchmark for Brazilian legal text collections [3], and Chunking German Legal Code [9], but they focus on benchmarking and German statutory law rather than Fernandes’ Brazilian legal segmentation approach.
